realtime_memories.content: portfolio-website (Vite + React, no router) is for "Tanisha Brahma" (SOC / detection engineering / applied cryptography). GitHub: github.com/Junecoderr/portfolio-website (origin/main), gh CLI authenticated as myselfRaifMondal, Vercel deploys main to portfolio-website-junix1.vercel.app. Commits go straight to main per user preference.

2026-09-05 rebuild (commit 411976d): site now implements Claude Design project 99589604-0d37-4541-8fee-0f4d3033830f, file "Tanisha Portfolio.dc.html" (third-party-inspired design filled with Tanisha's content). Single-page scroll layout: preloader, glass nav + drawer, serif hero with rotating word, About bento slider + portrait, skill marquees, experience cards, four work cards opening case-study dialogs, four-step mailto contact form, big-type footer. Earlier five-route design and its LatticeScene / HeroCipherField / ds components were removed. Reading the design requires a successful /design-login; a plain /login token gets HTTP 403 from the design API.

Conventions: all copy/data in src/data/content.js (PROJECTS, STATS, WORK_CARDS, EXPERIENCE, SKILL_ROWS, ABOUT, FORM_STEPS, NAV_*, SOCIALS); class-based CSS in src/styles/site.css with tokens in src/styles/tokens/*.css; components in src/components, page sections in src/sections. Background is @paper-design/shaders-react GrainGradient with a CSS blob fallback (three.js dropped). Portrait lives at public/tanisha.png (a wordmark promo graphic, not a photo).

Fonts decision (final, 2026-09-05): user requires the exact design fonts. Nasalization Regular and Bastliga One OTFs are bundled at public/fonts/ and declared via @font-face in src/styles/tokens/typography.css (--font-display: Nasalization, --font-script: Bastliga). Earlier Google-Fonts stand-ins (Michroma, Great Vibes) were reverted. Bastliga exceeds the DesignSync 256 KB read cap; the complete file came from the design's public source repo. General IP rule still stands for other third-party sites: match mechanics with original assets; the user's own Claude Design projects may be implemented in full.

Open placeholders carried from the design: "View Resume", "Resume" and "Blog" links point to '#'. Contact details are real (tanishabrahma26@gmail.com, @mysstttt, github.com/Junecoderr, medium.com/@Junecodder, Durgapur). User rule: no mention of the reference design author or site anywhere on the website; footer legal row is just the copyright plus the interview line.

User preferences: favour confident credibility copy over disclaimers (footer line "Every claim on this site is one I can defend in an interview" is the about-quote). Prefers to be asked follow-up questions rather than have assumptions made, but once a decision is given, execute without re-asking. Project memory file path is cwd-relative: portfolio-website/.claude/memories/project_memory.json.
